title: Core Drawing 004 — compare and select a spoon contour
alt_text: Two matching unshaded spoon line drawings are stacked. A close crop of the same fixed-view photo points to the bowl-to-neck edge. The upper drawing shows two light candidate curves there; the lower keeps one curve clearer and the other faint, with the rest of the spoon outline unchanged.
caption: Compare the two short bowl-to-neck curves with the same-view photo, then follow the curve that continues smoothly into the handle.
